paraphrase: Paid downloads and any in-app purchase of features, content, subscriptions or cloud services must use Google Play's billing system, except physical goods and services, bill payments, peer-to-peer payments, donations, gambling and other named exceptions where Play billing must not be used; apps may not steer users to another payment method through the listing, promotions, links, web views or sign-up flows; in-app currencies stay in the app they were bought for; pricing and terms must be clear and match the Play bill.
quote: apps may not lead users to a payment method other than Google Play's billing system
